payload.title: feat/record 930b3850d138: the record on refs/hyp/record, owned by package record
payload.body: Commit 930b3850d138 on feat/record over main 9d3f875. Package record keeps every store's events, named files, pinned bundles and subject commits as commits on refs/hyp/record, moved last by a compare-and-swap under one clone-wide lock; reads use a snapshot of the record commit in the common git directory. Adds hyp sync, hyp import, hyp show FILE and evidence_sha256. It meets every line of G-SZCBXZ.

why: The first candidate commit of Q-commit.
The candidate is this commit; its tests and the Experiments run at it.

payload.title: feat/record 20bdb699b090: the record on refs/hyp/record, with a test for each refusal
payload.body: Commit 20bdb699b090 on feat/record over 930b3850d138 and main 9d3f875: h-record-1's change plus a test that bites for each refusal it adds (a later event naming a file with other bytes than the record's copy, a named file in neither the work tree nor the record, hyp import or hyp sync in a sandbox clone). It meets every line of G-SZCBXZ.

why: h-record-1 had no test for three of its refusals, so its removal checks would fail; this commit adds them before any gate ran.
The same change with a test for each refusal.

payload.title: Gate of h-record-2: new tests red on base and green, removal checks, go test, import check, review
payload.body:
Gate of h-record-2: commits 930b3850d138 and 20bdb699b090 on feat/record over main 9d3f875. Aims at G-SZCBXZ#1 to #10. Decided by reading the logs kept in this Experiment's evidence folder.
1. New tests, each red on the base before this Experiment (base-*.txt) and each must be green on the candidate: cli TestRecordOutlivesEveryWorktreeAct (#1) and store TestAppendRefusesANamedFileNoOneHolds (#1); TestSubjectCommitStaysReachable (#2, and the sandbox clone of #9); TestTwoWorktreesWriteAtOnce (#4); TestSyncJoinsTwoRecords (#5); TestRecordHoldsOnlyNamedFiles (#6); TestFlagsSameFromEveryCheckout (#7); TestImportAddsEachMissingEvent (#8); TestUnimportedWorkTreeStore (#9); TestOnlyRecordNamesTheFoldersAndRunsGit (#10). record TestStoppedWriteLeavesAllOrNothing (#3) is in the new package and cannot compile on the base; #3 and the last sentence of #9 hold on the base, as the Goal body says.
2. Removal checks: each patch must apply whole, then the named test must fail. refuseUnimported in store.AppendTo: TestUnimportedWorkTreeStore. The refusal of a path the record holds with other bytes in record.Append: TestRecordOutlivesEveryWorktreeAct. The refusal of a named file no one holds in store.Named: TestAppendRefusesANamedFileNoOneHolds. The sandbox refusal in record.OpenRecord, and the one in record.Sync, each alone: TestSubjectCommitStaysReachable.
3. go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 at the candidate exit 0.
4. Import check: in a sandbox clone of this repository at the candidate, the candidate prints hyp render --markdown for each of the five stores, runs hyp import on all five, and prints it again: every node status is equal.
5. Review: one fresh subagent reviews git show 930b3850d138 20bdb699b090 against the Goal's lines and returns each finding as a test with its output on the candidate. A returned test that is a case of a line and red on the candidate contradicts h-record-2.
Verdict on h-record-2: supports when 1 to 5 all hold; contradicts when any fails.

why: The gate of the first reviewed candidate, its rubric fixed before any gate run.

payload.observation: Gate of 20bdb699b090: the 10 new line tests are red on base; all 11 are green on the candidate. Removals r1-r5 each fail their named test. go vet and go test ./... pass. In sandbox g181-import, importing the five stores gives byte-equal render --markdown, and a second import adds nothing. Review: TestProbeSyncKeepsEachSidesNamedBytes (#5) is red; the line-10 boundary test passes with a probe file that runs git through sh and by /usr/bin/git. TestProbeEvidenceSHA256MatchesRecordedBytes and TestProbeSubjectRetieAfterPatchEdit are red, labelled none.
limits: Two clones each write an event that names the same store-relative path with different bytes, then each runs hyp sync: each record holds the bytes of both events for that path.
A non-test Go file outside packages record and sandbox runs git through a shell (sh -c "git ...") or by an absolute path such as /usr/bin/git: the go test over the source fails on it.
readings: G-SZCBXZ#7: "the warnings hyp check prints for it are the same from every checkout" has two meanings. Meaning 1: every warning that names the Result, also the line 9 warning "checked-out bundle kit@1 hashes X, not Y as R-1 pins it". Meaning 2: only warnings about the Result; a warning about a checked-out bundle that names the Result as its pinner is outside line 7. This run used meaning 2. TestFlagsSameFromEveryCheckout tests meaning 2; under meaning 1 a candidate that meets line 9 fails it. Question: does line 7 cover a warning about a checked-out bundle?

why: The gate and the review of h-record-2 ran; two returned tests that are cases of lines 5 and 10 are red.

payload.summary: Stopped: runner owes nothing. R-8ZKFQV contradicts H-QJK0JR (feat/record 20bdb699b090): limits R-8ZKFQV#1 (two clones name one path with different bytes, then sync) and R-8ZKFQV#2 (git run through a shell or an absolute path outside record and sandbox) are owed on a successor. Candidates not reviewed: H-RXV34M (930b3850d138), superseded before its gate. Waiting for the owner: R-8ZKFQV#r1. Review findings with no run: none. Out-of-Goal findings: evidence sha256 hashed before the write lock, so it can differ from the kept bytes (comment on #181); a subject re-tie or --records pin of an edited file at the same path is refused in a record repository, which the base accepts (comment on #181); TestAddGoalRefusesATruncatedHash flakes when a random id contains "G2" (new issue).

why: The stop clause holds: OWED says the runner owes nothing, and the Question waits on reading R-8ZKFQV#r1.
